examples.english: After retirement, she has been engaged in various volunteer activities such as neighborhood cleaning and checking on the elderly.

notes:
A formal compound meaning volunteer or service activities performed for the benefit of the community without compensation. The word ⟦{奉仕|ほうし}→奉仕：17413_houshi⟧ (service, devotion) gives this term a slightly more formal and selfless nuance compared to the loanword ⟦ボランティア→ボランティア：04834_borantia⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {奉仕活動|ほうしかつどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧: to participate in volunteer work
- {奉仕活動|ほうしかつどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧: to engage in service activities
- ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧{奉仕活動|ほうしかつどう}: community service
- ⟦{清掃|せいそう}→清掃：04332_seisou⟧{奉仕活動|ほうしかつどう}: cleanup volunteer work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ボランティア→ボランティア：04834_borantia⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧: volunteer activities (more casual; the most common term in everyday speech)
- ⟦{社会貢献|しゃかいこうけん}→社会貢献：22315_shakaikouken⟧: social contribution (broader; includes corporate philanthropy and paid work that benefits society)
- {慈善活動|じぜんかつどう}: charity work (focuses on helping the poor or disadvantaged)

USAGE:
{奉仕活動|ほうしかつどう} is preferred in formal writing, school contexts, and official announcements. ⟦ボランティア→ボランティア：04834_borantia⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧ is more natural in casual conversation. Schools in Japan often organize {奉仕活動|ほうしかつどう} as part of the curriculum.
